subject: Request: Temporary 'No-PO' Onboarding Route for CloudNova Pilot
messages:
From: Asha Kapoor <asha@cloudnova.ai>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: procure@cloudnova.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for expedited onboarding — pilot (temporary no-PO)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudNova is excited to start the 60-day pilot next Monday. Our procurement team has a couple of timing constraints: the vendor onboarding team requires completed intake forms before they can process a PO, and CloudNova's purchasing cycles won't line up with Redwood's standard PO timeline for this pilot.

To avoid delaying the pilot launch, would Redwood consider a "temporary no-PO" onboarding route for CloudNova limited to marketing/pilot usage only? We can provide the attached SOW and the completed onboarding worksheet. If helpful, Liam (cc'ed) and I are available for a quick call to walk through the SOW and the use case constraints.

Attachments: CloudNova_SOW_v1.pdf; CloudNova_Onboarding_Form.xlsx

Ideal constraints from our side: pilot spend capped at $20k, single invoice at end of pilot, payment within 30 days. If Redwood needs a limited waiver or voucher to authorize the pilot without a formal PO, please let us know the required signoffs.

Appreciate the flexibility — we want to get traffic through the integration next week.

Best,
Asha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships | CloudNova.ai
asha@cloudnova.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@cloudnova.ai>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for expedited onboarding — pilot (temporary no-PO)

Hi Asha — thanks for the SOW and the intake form, received.

I'm looping in Markus (Procurement) and Laura (Finance) to evaluate a short-term exception path. A few immediate asks from our side so we can evaluate the risk and operational impact:

- Confirm the pilot start date (you noted next Monday) and whether any production traffic will be used against the pilot account.
- Confirm the single-invoice cadence (end of pilot) and provide the billing contact for accounts payable.
- Please confirm the $20k cap; Redwood policy requires a spend cap for temporary no-PO allowances.

Markus/Laura — can we provisionally approve an expedited onboarding corridor with the following guardrails if the vendor intake form looks complete?

- Timeboxed 90-day provisional exception (can be shorter if pilot ends earlier)
- Spend ceiling: $25,000 USD (to give a small buffer above CloudNova's requested cap)
- Required: signed onboarding form + SOW on file; vendor KYC completed by Procurement; invoice routed to the billing contact and marked "Pilot — no PO"

I'll start a short risk log for this vendor on the onboarding folder. If we need the formal PO waiver template, attached is Redwood_PO_Waiver_Template.pdf — Markus, please advise on any additional approvals.

Sooj
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for expedited onboarding — pilot (temporary no-PO)

Soojin / Markus — reviewed the materials Asha sent. Quick note on Finance stance and required controls: 

- We can approve a provisional, timeboxed "no-PO" onboarding for CloudNova limited to pilot scope under the following conditions:
  1) Hard cap of $25,000; Redwood to automatically pause billing above that threshold.
  2) Pilot invoice to be issued as a single consolidated invoice at pilot end; payment terms Net30.
  3) Procurement to complete vendor KYC and confirm tax / entity details (EIN, W9 or equivalent) prior to first invoice.
  4) Vendor must sign the MSA addendum (DocuSign link below) acknowledging pilot terms and data-use constraints.
  5) A business owner (Soojin/Markus) must confirm scope-of-work changes in writing — any scope creep requires conversion to a PO before additional spend is allowed.

Markus — please upload the completed CloudNova onboarding worksheet to the shared onboarding folder and confirm KYC checklist items. Once Procurement confirms, Finance will sign the Redwood_PO_Waiver_Template.pdf and return a countersigned copy.

Forwarding the key items we need from CloudNova (send to finance@redwood.com): billing contact, W9 (or local tax form), invoice remit address, and a point-of-contact for escalation.

Quote of previous message:
> I'm looping in Markus (Procurement) and Laura (Finance) to evaluate a short-term exception path. A few immediate asks from our side so we can evaluate the risk and operational impact:
> - Confirm the pilot start date (you noted next Monday) and whether any production traffic will be used against the pilot account.
> - Confirm the single-invoice cadence (end of pilot) and provide the billing contact for accounts payable.
> - Please confirm the $20k cap; Redwood policy requires a spend cap for temporary no-PO allowances.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@cloudnova.ai>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for expedited onboarding — pilot (temporary no-PO)

Hi Asha — great to close this out. Following Finance and Procurement review, Redwood can accept a provisional "no-PO" onboarding corridor for CloudNova under the conditions below: 

1) Timebox: up to 90 days from pilot start (per our queue, we applied 90 days to cover potential delays)
2) Spend cap: $25,000 USD total for the pilot; Redwood will automatically pause usage above this amount.
3) Required documents (please send ASAP to finance@redwood.com): signed onboarding worksheet (attached), completed W9 (or country equivalent), billing contact and remit address.
4) MSA addendum: please complete the DocuSign MSA addendum here: https://docusign.com/redwood/ENVELOPE-9247. The addendum includes the pilot terms and data-handling commitments.
5) Invoice cadence: single consolidated invoice at pilot end; Net30 payment terms.
6) Any scope changes must be approved in writing and convert to a PO for additional spend.

Next steps for CloudNova:
- Attach requested tax/billing docs to an email to finance@redwood.com (cc me).
- Complete DocuSign MSA addendum within 48 hours to keep the pilot start on track.

Markus will confirm vendor KYC is complete and return the countersigned PO waiver template once all items are verified. I'll keep the onboarding folder updated and send a calendar reminder the week before pilot end to prepare the invoice.

If you'd like a short handoff call to confirm AP details, Markus and I can join.

Thanks — excited to see the integration go live.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Waiver_Template.pdf, CloudNova_Onboarding_Form.xlsx
